name: Gunsmith Rosen
desc:
Gunsmith Rosen is the current leader of the arms company known as [The Summer Company](faction:the_summer_company). He is responsible for reintroducing guns across the Luminants. His aspect is also Vesperian. Its unknown if Rosen resides within [Summer Isle](location:summer_isle) but it is assumed so due to him signing off the creation of the Stormseye.

[Gunsmith Hierka](entity:gunsmith_hierka) was Rosen's former protégé who deceived Rosen and hid his ranking as a member of [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority)'s [Bureau of Research](faction:bureau_of_research) in order to steal the Summer Company's Secrets. This would go on to spark the invention of the Rifle Spear, a standard issue weapon for the Authority.

While Rosen is known for his mechanical expertise, he has shown himself to still be skilled in designs that revolve around the manipulation of ether.
additional_info:
-   Concept art has depicted him as a Canor as well as a Vesperian.
-   While the Flintlock was designed by Rosen he only made the first Prototype, it now is mass produced by various gunsmiths.
-   He also wore Rosen's Ring, which gives 1.2 INT scaling, but he lost it for an unknown reason, and so now the player can obtain it.
-   The name "Gunsmith Rosen" could be a reference to the famous 90s rock band Guns N' Roses.
